prompt.en: During a digital-mode test, the waterfall looks clean on receive but transmitted tones are badly overdriven and wide. Which first adjustment fits the interface problem?

text.en: Reduce the computer playback or interface drive level
Increase RF output power to hide the distortion
Raise the radio data-input gain for more ALC indication

explanation.en: Digital-mode interfaces must feed clean audio at a suitable level; excessive audio drive causes a wide, distorted transmitted signal before RF power or antenna matching can fix anything.

prompt.en: A linear regulator has 19 V at its input, 13.8 V at its output, and supplies 3 A. About how much heat must it dissipate?

explanation.en: The regulator drops 19 V - 13.8 V = 5.2 V; 5.2 V x 3 A = 15.6 W of heat.

prompt.en: A club member wants to check ripple inside an old mains-powered supply after it has been unplugged. Which plan is the safe starting point?

text.en: Confirm capacitors are discharged and use qualified service procedures
Short the filter capacitor with a screwdriver before measuring
Probe the live primary wiring to make the ripple easier to see
Lift the safety ground so the oscilloscope trace is cleaner

explanation.en: Power-supply capacitors can retain dangerous energy; internal checks require discharged capacitors, proper test gear, and someone qualified to work safely around mains equipment.
